targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  DISTINCT ON(name) name AS "Name",
  entity_id AS "ID",
  ST_X(location) AS "Längengrad",
  ST_Y(location) AS "Breitengrad",
  entity_type AS "Sensor Typ"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se" 
WHERE inactive = 'false'

SELECT 
  DISTINCT on(name) name AS "Name",
  entity_id AS "ID",
  ST_X(location) AS "Breitengrad",
  ST_Y(location) AS "Längengrad",
  entity_type AS "Sensor Typ"
FROM "etair-quality-station"
WHERE inactive = 'false'

SELECT 
  DISTINCT ON(name) name AS "Name",
  entity_id AS "ID",
  ST_X(location) AS "Breitengrad",
  ST_Y(location) AS "Längengrad",
  entity_type AS "Sensor Typ"
FROM "etdo300-parking-barrier"
WHERE "inactive" = 'false';

SELECT 
  DISTINCT ON(name) name AS "Name",
  entity_id AS "ID",
  ST_X(location) AS "Breitengrad",
  ST_Y(location) AS "Längengrad",
  entity_type AS "Sensor Typ"
FROM "etlibelium-weather" 
WHERE inactive = 'false'

SELECT 
  DISTINCT ON(name) name AS "Name",
  entity_id AS "ID",
  ST_X(location) AS "Breitengrad",
  ST_Y(location) AS "Längengrad",
  entity_type AS "Sensor Typ"
FROM "etwater-level-sensor" 
WHERE inactive = 'false'

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name as __key,
  avg(temperature) AS "WS"
FROM
  "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
  AND temperature BETWEEN -30 AND 50
GROUP BY
  time,
  name
ORDER BY
  1;

SELECT 
"time_index" AS "time",
"pressure"
FROM "mtsmartcity"."etlibelium-weather"
ORDER BY time_index DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  LAST("powerpv", time_index) AS "Haus"
FROM "etclimate-quarter-house"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT 
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS "time",
  AVG(particulatematter10) AS "PM10",
  AVG(particulatematter2_5) AS "PM2,5",
  AVG(particulatematter1_0) AS "PM1,0"
FROM "etair-quality-station" 
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Relative Luftfeuchtigkeit

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(precipitation) AS "WS"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
GROUP BY time, name
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  avg("heatpumppower") AS "Haus"
FROM "etclimate-quarter-house"
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT 
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS "time",
  AVG(soundlevel) AS "Lärmpegel"
FROM "etair-quality-station" 
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(windspeed) as "WS"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
GROUP BY time, name
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  name AS __key,
  avg(solarRadiation) AS "WS"
FROM "etfroggit-wh-4000-se"
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index) 
GROUP BY time, name
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  time_index as time,
  waterLevelWarning as warninglevel
FROM "etwater-level-sensor"
WHERE entity_id like 'urn:ngsi-ld:water-level-sensor:LEVEL10030'
ORDER By time desc
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS time,
  waterlevel as "Pegelstand",
  entity_id as "Name"
FROM "etwater-level-sensor"
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
  and entity_id like 'urn:ngsi-ld:water-level-sensor:LEVEL10030'
GROUP BY time_index, entity_id, waterlevel

SELECT 
  time_bucket('$__interval', time_index) AS "time",
  occupied
FROM "etdo300-parking-barrier" 
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time_index)
GROUP BY time, occupied
ORDER BY time, occupied
